definition: Ali Ghodsi (born 1978) is an Iranian-Swedish-American computer scientist and entrepreneur, specializing in distributed systems, big data and data management.
details: Co-created Apache Mesos and Ray, and leads Databricks in unifying lakehouse data architecture with enterprise AI engineering. He is a co-founder and CEO of Databricks and an adjunct professor at UC Berkeley. He co-authored several influential papers, including Apache Mesos and Apache Spark SQL. Ghodsi holds a PhD in computer science.

explainer.lead: Ali Ghodsi is a Swedish computer scientist.

contributions.name: Ghodsi was a co-founder of Peerialism AB, a Stockholm-based company developing a peer-to-peer data transfer system.
He also co-invented the concept of dominant resource fairness, in a paper that heavily influenced resource management and scheduling design in distributed systems such as Hadoop.

timeline.what: In 2002, Ghodsi received an MSc degree in computer engineering and an MBA in logistics and strategic marketing from Mid-Sweden University.
In 2006, Ghodsi received his PhD in distributed computing from KTH Royal Institute of Technology in Sweden, advised by computer scientist and professor Seif Haridi.

He joined UC Berkeley in 2009 as a visiting scholar and worked with Scott Shenker, Ion Stoica, Michael Franklin, and Matei Zaharia on research projects in distributed systems, database systems, and networking.
In 2026, Ghodsi was named to Time 100's most influential people in artificial intelligence.
